candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order service (db, payment, inventory) not yet isolated; only the failing hop is established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with order service returning 500 on /v1/orders in logs and traces; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Deeper cause within order is unconfirmed.
